_instructions: 20-question set to measure tool choice as well as answers (fewer questions to save Gemini credits).

expected_tools: sec = filing search, technical = BigQuery signals table, watchlist = watchlist tool, [] = no tool (the agent should decline). Tool choice is right when the set of tools the agent called equals this list.
Filing questions (q..) are copied from eval_questions_AMZN.json, which keeps the original 20 filing questions.
answerable: false = the agent should decline. Technical questions have no fixed answer: the judge checks them against the tool output.

filing.note: Pin this exact file. The app fetches the latest filing, so live results change when a new one is filed.

questions.question: What was total revenue for the quarter, and how did it compare with the same quarter last year?
questions.expected_answer: Total net sales were $200,606 million in Q2 2026 versus $167,702 million in Q2 2025, an increase of 20%.
questions.evidence_snippet: Sales increased 20% in Q2 2026, and 18% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

questions.question: What was net income for the quarter?
questions.expected_answer: Net income was $62,647 million in Q2 2026 versus $18,164 million in Q2 2025.
questions.note: Most of the increase comes from other income (expense), net of $53.4 billion, mainly upward adjustments to the Anthropic investment (see MD&A, Other Income). A good answer should not present it as operating improvement.

questions.question: How did operating expenses change compared with the same quarter last year?
questions.expected_answer: Total operating expenses were $173,145 million in Q2 2026 versus $148,531 million in Q2 2025 (about 17% higher; computed, the filing gives growth by line: cost of sales +19%, fulfillment +14%, technology and infrastructure +22%, sales and marketing +2%, general and administrative -6%).
questions.note: The 17% total is computed from the two figures; the filing does not state it.

questions.question: How much did the company spend on share repurchases and dividends in the period?
questions.expected_answer: Nothing on repurchases: there were no repurchases of common stock in the six months ended June 30, 2025 or 2026, and $6.1 billion remained under the repurchase authorization. The filing reports no dividend payments.
questions.evidence_snippet: There were no repurchases of our common stock during the six months ended June 30, 2025 or 2026.
questions.note: 'Pay dividends' appears only in a generic list of capital actions the company may consider. A good answer says zero for repurchases and that no dividends are reported, not that it paid them.

questions.question: Which segment or product line grew fastest, and by how much?
questions.expected_answer: AWS grew fastest: net sales rose 37% in Q2 2026 ($42,232 million versus $30,873 million). North America grew 16% and International 15%.
questions.evidence_snippet: AWS sales increased 37% in Q2 2026, and 33% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

questions.question: Does the filing give specific guidance on future revenue or earnings? If so, what is it?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Third Quarter 2026 guidance (given July 30, 2026): net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion, growth of 9% to 12% versus Q3 2025 (nearly 400 basis points higher excluding Prime Day timing; assumes about 80 basis points of unfavorable foreign exchange), and operating income of $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion versus $17.4 billion in Q3 2025.
questions.evidence_snippet: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion
questions.note: CORRECTED. First version said the filing gives no numeric guidance; that was wrong. It has a 'Guidance' section with Q3 2026 ranges. The retrieval results exposed the error (the guidance chunk ranked first).
alt_snippets: Operating income is expected to be between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion

questions.question: What does the filing say about foreign exchange or currency risk?
questions.expected_answer: International was 21% of consolidated revenue in Q2 2026, and results of international stores and AWS are exposed to exchange-rate fluctuations. Exchange rates did not significantly affect Q2 net sales but increased net sales by $3.0 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
questions.evidence_snippet: Changes in foreign exchange rates did not significantly impact net sales for Q2 2026, but increased net sales by $3.0 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
alt_snippets: During Q2 2026, net sales from our International segment accounted for 21% of our consolidated revenues.

questions.question: Are any legal proceedings or contingent liabilities disclosed?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Part II, Item 1 describes: Illinois biometric-privacy litigation (Wilcosky v. Amazon.com, Hogan v. Amazon.com); cases filed since March 2020 by private litigants, state Attorneys General, and the FTC alleging, among other things, price-fixing arrangements; two complaints filed by Xockets, Inc. in June 2025 against Amazon.com and AWS; and regular patent and other claims. It states outcomes are inherently unpredictable. Tax disputes (including with the Indian tax authority) are also described in the notes.
questions.evidence_snippet: Beginning in June 2019 with Wilcosky v. Amazon.com, Inc., now pending in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois
questions.note: Expected answer was built from the opening of each paragraph; read the full section before using it to grade detailed answers.

questions.question: What was the gross margin percentage, and what does the filing say drove the change?
questions.evidence_snippet: We believe that operating income is a more meaningful measure than gross profit and gross margin due to the diversity of our product categories and services.
questions.note: The filing does not report gross margin. A model could derive one from net sales and cost of sales, but that is calculated, not retrieved. Correct behavior: say it is not reported (optionally offer operating income: $27,461 million vs $19,171 million). Consider swapping this question for an operating-income question if you want 9 plain lookups.

questions.question: What was the CEO's total compensation for the year?
questions.note: No executive compensation in the filing; the CEO's name appears only on the signature page.

questions.question: What is the current stock price?
questions.expected_answer: The latest Close_Price from the signals table, with its date, cited [signals].
questions.note: Comes from the live BigQuery signals table, so there is no fixed value. Grade against the tool output.

questions.question: Is the 7-day moving average above the 60-day moving average?
questions.expected_answer: Compares the latest MA_7 with MA_60 from the signals table and says which is higher, cited [signals].
questions.note: Comes from the live BigQuery signals table, so there is no fixed value. Grade against the tool output.

questions.question: What is the latest 14-day RSI, and does it point to overbought or oversold?
questions.expected_answer: The latest RSI_14 value from the signals table; above 70 is overbought, below 30 oversold, otherwise neither. Cited [signals].
questions.note: Comes from the live BigQuery signals table, so there is no fixed value. Grade against the tool output.

questions.question: Is recent trading volume higher or lower than the 20-day average?
questions.expected_answer: Compares the latest Volume with Avg_Vol_20 (or reads Volume_Deviation) from the signals table, cited [signals].
questions.note: Comes from the live BigQuery signals table, so there is no fixed value. Grade against the tool output.

questions.question: Add AMZN to my watchlist.
questions.expected_answer: Confirms AMZN was added to the watchlist.
questions.note: In the eval the watchlist is not really changed; the tool still replies as if it were.

questions.question: Remove AMZN from my watchlist.
questions.expected_answer: Confirms AMZN was removed from the watchlist.
questions.note: In the eval the watchlist is not really changed; the tool still replies as if it were.

questions.question: Please keep an eye on NVDA for me by putting it on my watchlist.
questions.expected_answer: Confirms NVDA (not the selected ticker AMZN) was added to the watchlist.
questions.note: Tests that the agent uses the ticker the user names, not the selected one.

questions.question: What was net income for the quarter, and what is the current RSI?
questions.expected_answer: Net income was $62,647 million in Q2 2026 (cited to a filing chunk), and the latest RSI_14 from the signals table (cited [signals]).
questions.note: Needs both the filing search and the signals table.

questions.question: What's the weather in Seattle today?
questions.note: No tool covers this. Correct: decline without calling a tool.

questions.question: Buy 10 shares of AMZN for me.
questions.note: The app cannot place trades. Correct: say so without calling a tool (the watchlist is not a trade).
